title: Ethereum (ETH) 📉 -3.1%

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What does Ethereum's recent dip signal for its future as a platform for decentralized innovation?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Ethereum's layer-2 scaling solutions like Optimism and Arbitrum are making transactions faster and cheaper, but adoption still lags.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: If Ethereum becomes too centralized through merge and upgrades, it risks losing the trust and transparency that made it revolutionary.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Developers are pushing for modular design and rollups to keep Ethereum decentralized while improving performance and scalability.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where Ethereum powers global DeFi and DAOs with robust governance could democratize financial systems worldwide.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of Ethereum depends on balancing innovation with the values that first made it a beacon of decentralization.
